templates.current:
**{total} projects, of which {baseline} are user-reference projects and {added} were added in this round.** Feature verification: {reviewed}; metrics snapshot: `{as_of}` (UTC).

Within each category, projects are first tiered by maintenance status, then ranked by a blend of stars (40%), 90-day default-branch commits (35%) and recency of the last commit (25%). The maintenance score does not represent design quality, model capability, accessibility or production readiness.
templates.shortlist_note: Shows only core candidates with a verified open license and commits in the last 90 days; restricted-license projects, research benchmarks and adjacent tools are excluded from this table.
templates.toc_note: `★User reference` marks projects provided directly by the user. Each repository appears in one primary category only; the project detail table records dependencies and limitations.
templates.detail_intro: Each positioning statement comes from the official README at a pinned commit; not every project was installed and run. Metrics refreshes do not automatically re-audit features or licenses.
templates.rankings_intro: Snapshot: `{as_of}`. This is a ranking of GitHub maintenance metadata, not a design-quality leaderboard. All views tier by maintenance status first.
